  • Regional casualties: Kuwaiti army reports at least 10 soldiers injured in an Iranian strike.
  • US leadership posture: President Trump said the US is working to control the Strait of Hormuz and repeated that negotiations are “going very well.” A US official warned a ‘Zero Hour’ is near — enough forces for a significant ground operation by early next week.

  • Diplomacy/mediation: Pakistan is mediating. Pakistani FM says US–Iran talks may occur in Islamabad in the coming days; open-source markets raise probability of US–Iran meeting by April 30. Iran denies direct talks (contextual).
  • Threat messaging: IRGC Aerospace commander warned of strikes on more “valuable” US/Israeli facilities.
  • Security incident (US mainland): Helicopters scrambled after an unknown drone incursion near Air Force One at West Palm Beach Airport; incident under development.
  • Operational context: This is the ongoing pattern — kinetic strikes inside Iran followed by missile and rocket counterstrikes into Israel and daily Hezbollah harassment on the northern border.

  • Escalating
